title: chat.server.ts reads its system prompt, algorithm, products, shared docs, blog index and posture files from disk once at import and never refreshes them.
evidence: (a) Module lets filled by try/readFileSync relative to process.cwd(): ALGORITHM_DOC (app/lib/chat.server.ts:55-62) and PRODUCTS_DOC (:69-75); the system prompt moved to chat-system-prompt.server.ts, which since US-15 AC65 (7495d2959) refuses a chat when it is missing (CHAT_PROMPT.kind). A failed read only logs and leaves an empty string. Import also runs loadSharedDoc (:85-92, which reports missing files to Sentry), BLOG_INDEX = loadBlogIndex() (:106), KNOWLEDGE_OVERVIEW (:136), EVIDENCE_DOC (:158), SYSTEM_PROMPT_WITH_ALGORITHM (:166) and exported DOCTOR_POSTURE and BRAND_POSTURE (:186-187). (b) buildSystemBlocks (:243) reads them. Nothing writes them after load. There is no reset seam, and about 22 test files vi.mock('./chat.server') rather than load it, e.g. app/lib/discord-bot.history.test.ts:32. (c) Owner: a createChatDocs(root) returning {systemPrompt, algorithm, productsBlock, knowledgeOverview, evidence, postures}, called once in the server entry and passed to buildSystemBlocks. The empty-string fallbacks would then become one explicit missing-docs check at startup. (d) Risk: a missing file at boot gives a silently degraded prompt for the life of the process. Results depend on the cwd tests run from. Edited docs need a restart. app/lib/chat-router.server.ts:36 makes a second import-time loadBlogIndex() call.
